name: broadset-workspace
description: Workspace scaffold for the Broadset rebuild

scripts.build:workspaces: npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run build -w @broadset/demo
scripts.typecheck:workspaces: npm run typecheck -w @broadset/model && npm run typecheck -w @broadset/playback && npm run typecheck -w @broadset/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @broadset/editor && npm run typecheck -w @broadset/formats && npm run typecheck -w @broadset/ui && npm run typecheck -w @broadset/demo
scripts.ct:all: npm run ct -w @broadset/ui && npm run ct -w @broadset/demo
scripts.quality:workspaces: npm run quality -w @broadset/model && npm run quality -w @broadset/playback && npm run quality -w @broadset/renderer && npm run quality -w @broadset/editor && npm run quality -w @broadset/formats && npm run quality -w @broadset/ui && npm run quality -w @broadset/demo
scripts.quality:strict:workspaces: npm run quality:strict -w @broadset/model && npm run quality:strict -w @broadset/playback && npm run quality:strict -w @broadset/renderer && npm run quality:strict -w @broadset/editor && npm run quality:strict -w @broadset/formats && npm run quality:strict -w @broadset/ui && npm run quality:strict -w @broadset/demo
scripts.gate:full: npm run test:docs && npm run docs:check && npm run test:roadmap && npm run roadmap:check && npm run lint:typecoverage && npm run quality:strict && npm run lint:dead && npm run ct:all && npm run build
